messages:
maria: Rolling out header-toggle + model-variant pin for EU region only first. Need quick crosses: runtime, api, router, console. Plan: canary 3% -> 20% -> 100% (regional). rollback triggers: CPU > 75% for 5m OR api 5xx > 0.7% over 10m.

sam: runtime: confirm this touches model-selection header key AND introduces a short-lived feature flag?

maria: yes, `X-Model-Select-Alt` and runtime flag `model_select_alt_enabled`. flag will default off; we enable for canary shards.

oliver: router: we'll do a route rule for eu-west shards and add a header passthrough. can we avoid stripping on the default path? prefer no global change.

kai: api: we'll accept both headers but prefer the new one if present. will instrument metrics to report header usage per route.

ara: console: pushing a small opt-in toggle to users in EU console. also updating release notes: "EU opt-in: header toggle + model variant pin."

maria: deploybot, preflight please. need infra health, canary slot, monitor hooks, and a pending dead-man switch TTL set.

deploybot: preflight started for 'eu-header-pin' wave. checks in progress.

deploybot: infra-health ok, canary-slot ok, monitor-hooks ok, dead-man TTL set to 30m.

maria: checklist: 1) router route for eu (oliver) 2) runtime flag staged (sam) 3) api header metrics (kai) 4) console opt-in gated (ara) 5) docs/release notes published (jen) 6) deploybot armed (maria)

oliver: applied route rule to eu-west shards, header passthrough active under canary tag. added temporary shard tag `canary-eu-1`.

sam: runtime toggle merged to prod but OFF. I'll flip to ON for canary once deploybot proceeds. unit tests green.

kai: api metric: new header seen in staging 1200 requests/min. pushing a short synthetic to eu canary now.

maria: starting 3% canary for EU only. deploybot start wave.

deploybot: wave started  eu-header-pin  canary=3%  initiated by maria  ts=7101234590

jen: watching release-notes publish. tagging docs PR: rnotes/3224.

ara: console errors dashboard clear. user opt-ins quiet.

oliver: router: no increased 4xx or route drops. latency unchanged.

sam: flipped runtime flag to ON for canary shards. monitoring KV hitrate and model selection histograms.

kai: api 10m: 5xx=0.2%, new-header usage 2.4% (as expected). no action yet.

maria: good. plan to step to 20% in 12m. reminder rollback CLI: `deploybot rollback --wave=eu-header-pin --reason=errs`

jen: adding quick rollback steps to notes: pin console to v1, remove canary shard tag, set runtime flag OFF, and unpublish docs if needed.

ara: small ops note: after rollback wait 10m before toggling flag off to ensure in-flight requests drain.

sam: ack. also will rotate a short-lived metrics tag so we can identify traffic pre/post rollback.

deploybot: scheduled increase to 20% at ts=7101235310 (12m). monitors: cpu, 5xx_rate, header_usage. dead-man TTL 30m active.

maria: thanks everyone. i'll post a summary when 20% completes. :rocket:
